annotation.kind: faithfulness rebuild of the computed CGS-P first-column residual identity and equation (16)

assumptions: The dimensions m and n are positive, n is at most m, and the rectangular input A has full column rank.
Q and upper-triangular R are the computed factors represented by the proof-carrying CGS-P first-column execution contract.
Every leading block of R has a certified inverse and satisfies condition (3): c4(m,k)*epsilonM*kappa2(R_k)^2 < 1.
The machine unit epsilonM is nonnegative, the first diagonal r11 is positive, and the computed normalization has q1=(I+G1)*a1/r11 with induced spectral norm ||G1||_2 <= epsilonM.
The real-valued error certificate represents the paper's IEEE normalized finite regime; exceptional values and any higher-order terms suppressed by the surrounding analysis are outside the claim.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P11 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P11 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p11_t1_first_column_residual_action {m n : Nat} (run : P11CGSPFirstColumnRun m n) : P11Equation16 run
formal_statement.plain_language: For the computed first column of any admissible CGS-P run, derive the exact normalization and factorization-residual identities and the complete equation-(16) spectral/Euclidean norm chain ending at epsilonM times the input-column norm.

informal_proof: Substitute the computed normalization relation into A1-Q1*R1 and cancel the positive r11 to obtain -G1*a1. Identify the one-column matrix norm with the Euclidean norm of its column, remove the minus sign, apply the exact spectral operator-norm action bound, and multiply ||G1||_2 <= epsilonM by the nonnegative norm of a1.
informal_statement: The exact computed CGS-P first-column residual identity and complete induced-2-norm chain in equation (16).
